input.quote: ARTICLE III OWNERSHIP Licensee acknowledges that Licensor owns all right, title, and interest in and to the Licensed Technology and all Intellectual Property Rights therein.
input.rationale: Article III is a one-way ownership clause: Licensor owns the Licensed Technology and all Intellectual Property Rights therein, and "Intellectual Property Rights" (1.6) is defined solely as rights "of Licensor". "Derivative Work" (1.3) sweeps in "any additions, modifications, improvements or enhancements based upon or incorporating the Licensed Technology", so the bespoke customization and unique client front end we commission and pay for under Article VII(b) vest in Licensor. There is no assignment to us and no licence back beyond the limited, non-exclusive Field-of-Use licence, which terminates on expiry with an obligation to return everything (Article XXI). The Agreement is also silent on our data: Confidential Information (1.2) protects only information disclosed to Licensee, and nothing confirms we retain our trading, order, client and account data. Vendor keeping its platform is fine, but the clause fails even the fallback (no perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense deliverables) and leaves Customer Data ownership unaddressed. We added a narrow carve-out: we retain our data and IP; paid-for deliverables are assigned to us with Licensor retaining its pre-existing IP and granting a perpetual, royalty-free licence back for embedded materials; and no joint ownership is created.

proposal.summary: Add Licensee ownership of its data and of paid-for customization deliverables, with a licence-back of embedded Licensor IP and no joint ownership.
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Article III gives Licensor ownership of the Licensed Technology and all Derivative Works but says nothing about our data or about the customization work we commission and pay for under Article VII(b), leaving us with no ownership and no surviving licence. We have added a carve-out confirming we retain our trading and client data, that paid-for deliverables are assigned to us subject to Licensor retaining its pre-existing IP (licensed back to us on a perpetual, royalty-free basis), and that no joint ownership is created; if Licensor prefers, we can instead take a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense those deliverables.

ops.text: Notwithstanding the foregoing: (i) Licensee retains all right, title and interest in and to all data and content submitted by or on behalf of Licensee to, or generated by Licensee's use of, the Licensed Technology, including Licensee's trading, order, position, client and account data ("Licensee Data"), and nothing in this Agreement transfers or assigns to Licensor any ownership of Licensee Data or of any other intellectual property of Licensee; (ii) all customization work, client front ends, deliverables and other work product developed by Licensor specifically for Licensee and paid for by Licensee (including pursuant to Article VII(b)) (the "Licensee Deliverables") shall be owned by Licensee, and Licensor hereby assigns to Licensee all right, title and interest therein, excluding Licensor's pre-existing Intellectual Property Rights and the underlying Licensed Technology, which Licensor retains and in respect of which Licensor grants Licensee a perpetual, irrevocable, worldwide, royalty-free licence to use, modify and sublicense such retained materials solely as embedded in the Licensee Deliverables; and (iii) nothing in this Agreement creates any joint ownership of intellectual property.
